description: arXiv:2609.17857v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Who the judge is can affect an LLM-as-judge result, but measuring that effect without confusing it with candidate quality is difficult. We study four open-weight families (Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, Gemma 2, and Yi 1.5) in a fully crossed pairwise design with 9,312 judgments. A common per-family statistic is strongly confounded with candidate quality...
author: David Ababio Awuni, Luke E. K. Achenie, Benjamin Tei Partey, Elvis Gyasi Owusu, Nii-Nai Derrick Sowah
